payload.goalOutcome:
Build a complete Personal Task Manager web application with a functional frontend, backend REST API, and SQLite database.

The application must:
1. Create tasks with title and description.
2. Edit existing tasks.
3. Mark tasks as complete.
4. Delete tasks.
5. Filter tasks by status (all, active, completed).
6. Persist data in SQLite across server restarts.
7. Serve a clean responsive web UI.
8. Provide a REST API for all CRUD operations.

After producing all files, npm test MUST exit 0 within 60 seconds.

payload.rationale: Scope "standard" in domain "software-engineering" with 1 capability needs. Planned 1 specialist role(s): Software Engineer [code-execution]. No coordinator: fewer than 3 specialists.
